title: Stabilization of cohomology reduction images
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], with $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal F$ as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). Fix $p\ge0$, put $H=H^p(X,\mathcal F)$ and $M_n=H^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ for $n\ge1$ (sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]; these are $A$-modules, $a\in A$ acting through the image of $a$ in $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$), let $\rho_n:H\to M_n$ be the $A$-linear map induced by the quotient map $\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$, and for $k\ge n$ let $\tau_{k,n}:M_k\to M_n$ be the map induced by the quotient map $\mathcal F/\mathcal I^k\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ (so $\tau_{k,n}\circ\rho_k=\rho_n$). Then there is c >= 0 such that Im(tau_(k,n)) = Im(rho_n) for every n >= 1 and k >= n+c.

proof.text: Put J = I O_X and P_n = J^n F, with monic image inclusions j_n : P_n -> F. The cokernel sequences S_n = (P_n -> F -> F/P_n) are short exact by Mathlib ShortComplex.exact_cokernel. Obtain the cohomological delta-functor with degree functors moduleCohomology from pqf-def-cohomology. Its exact_right, exact_left and naturality fields give the needed exact rows and natural connecting maps. The quotient transitions commute with projections by cokernel.π_desc.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-powers-ideal-application only in degree p+1 and retain its transition maps i, compatibility i_(k,n) j_n = j_k, and kernel threshold c. Cancellation of the monic j_n proves composition of i. The degree-zero product inclusion j_0 is an isomorphism: J^0 is O_X, its multiplication on F is the left unitor, and the image inclusion of this epimorphism is epi and mono. Thus the kernel of H^(p+1)(i_(k,0)) is the kernel of H^(p+1)(j_k).

For k >= n+c and x in H^p(F/P_k), let y = delta_k(x). Exact_left gives H^(p+1)(j_k)(y)=0. The degree-zero comparison gives H^(p+1)(i_(k,0))(y)=0. Since c <= k, the kernel equality gives H^(p+1)(i_(k,k-c))(y)=0; restricting scalars in that equality changes neither the underlying maps nor their zero conditions. Since n <= k-c, composition gives H^(p+1)(i_(k,n))(y)=0. The short-complex morphism (i_(k,n), identity F, quotient transition) and delta naturality imply delta_n(tau_(k,n)(x))=0. Exact_right, via ShortComplex.Exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker, places tau_(k,n)(x) in the image of rho_n.

Conversely, the identity rho_k followed by tau_(k,n) equals rho_n follows from cokernel.π_desc and functoriality. Every rho_n(x) is therefore tau_(k,n)(rho_k(x)), giving the reverse range inclusion. Set.Subset.antisymm proves the equality for all positive n and k >= n+c.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 02OB, part (3), proof lines 5615-5645; formalized by T1 using the existing cohomological delta-functor and only the degree p+1 threshold of 02OA.

mathlib_searches.query: For a coherent sheaf on a proper scheme over a Noetherian ring, kernels of cohomology reduction modulo powers of an ideal have a uniform Artin Rees bound and images of transition maps stabilize.

lean.statement:
theorem ml_cohomology_powers_ideal_image_stabilization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f]
    (I : Ideal A) (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ,
      (∀ (n k : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ h : n + c ≤ k,
        Set.range (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).map
          (formalModuleQuotientMap
            ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
              (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
            (𝟙 F) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right n c) h))).hom) =
        Set.range (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ
            ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
              (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) n F)).hom))
